name: In 2/4 or 4/4 time, Slowrock rhythm divides each beat into an 8th-note triplet (chùm liên 3)

then.description: In 2/4 or 4/4 time, Slowrock rhythm divides each beat into an 8th-note triplet (chùm liên 3). The first note of the triplet is played strong (bass/downbeat), while the 2nd and 3rd notes are played light (right-hand chord fill).
